To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a multi-objective MILP synthesis of dynamic supply-networks, under uncertainty, for achieving maximal profit, while protecting the environment.

The multi-objective MILP model is able to obtain the optimal dynamic company's supply-network that integrates renewable energy sources under uncertainties related to products’ demands and sun radiation".
the integration of renewables and wastes into a dynamic supply-network is a promising way to achieve energy self-suffiency, while reducing CO2 emissions and increasing profit.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a multi-objective MILP synthesis of a company supply-network under uncertainty.
the development of a multi-objective MILP model for the synthesis of an energy self-sufficient company's supply network, and with its application in the case study of a food industry.
the design of environmentally-benigne energy self-sufficient dynamic supply-networks under uncertainty.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the proposed model is able to synthesise a company's supply-network under uncertainty, accounting for the integration of renewable energies and wastes, while considering dynamic market conditions and multi-objective optimisations.
this contribution presents a multi-criteria MILP model for achieving energy-self-sufficiency by the integration of renewables into companies' dynamic supply-networks under uncertainty.
the proposed methodology is a useful and powerful tool for companies' supply-network planning, as it enables them to achieve their goals under uncertainty, while also being environmentally friendly.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the developed multi-objective MILP model for dynamic energy self-sufficient supply-networks has been extended in order to account for uncertainties and multi-objective optimisations, which are the main contributions of this work.

the proposed model is able to find the most sustainable solutions for a company's supply-network, which is capable of achieving energy self-sufficient operation by integrating renewable energy and other wastes, while accounting for dynamic changes in supply and demand over time, and for uncertainties in products' demand and in sun radiation.
the proposed multi-objective model has been extended to account also for the dynamic consideration, for uncertainties and for multi-objectives.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, by considering the dynamic aspect of a company's supply-network, the obtained solutions are more realistic, and therefore, more applicable.
the integration of renewables in a company's supply-network is a sustainable solution for achieving energy selfsufficiency.
the multi-objective MILP synthesis of a dynamic company's supply-network is a useful tool for the design of energy self-sufficient and environmentally-benign supply-networks under uncertainty.
